question: in-depth assessment: is there ANY multimodal signal between images and the tabular registry?
design: 477 individual registry variables (from 1431 columns / 1013 numeric, after euro-decimal parsing, dropping administrative fields, >=60% coverage, >=3 levels), each tested separately against pooled-USFM image PCs. Held-out ridge on 10 image PCs, 5-fold, BOTH sides residualised on GA + EFW + 5 biometry z-scores. Plus a block-level arm with the full adjustment ladder and permutation nulls.

FINDING_1_habitus_dominates.reading: the single strongest image<->tabular signal in the entire registry is MATERNAL BODY HABITUS -- BMI, weight and waist circumference, in ten near-duplicate encodings occupying the top of the ranking. It is an ACQUISITION CONFOUND: higher BMI degrades ultrasound penetration, so the encoder reads maternal habitus off image quality. Residualising the images on BMI collapses the whole maternal block from +0.384 to -0.014.

FINDING_2_best_non_habitus_also_collapse.reading: blood pressure is the strongest non-habitus hit at 0.215, but BP correlates 0.332 with BMI and the signal collapses to 0.046 the moment BMI enters the adjustment, ending at 0.037 (p=0.12) with presentation and echo quality also removed. Same confound.

corrected.note: positive, but measurement recovery: biometry is measured from these images

cardiac_raw_morphology.note: marginal, and this block has the highest GA leakage after Doppler

FINDING_3_blocks.reading: only maternal clears its null decisively, and maternal is the confound

ANSWER: Of 477 registry variables the median adjusted correlation is -0.005 and only 7.3% exceed 0.15. Two things clear their nulls. (1) MATERNAL BODY HABITUS (BMI 0.493, ten near-duplicate encodings) -- an ACQUISITION confound: higher BMI degrades ultrasound penetration, and residualising images on BMI collapses the maternal block from +0.384 to -0.014. (2) FETAL BIOMETRY (+0.159 after GA and BMI, p=0.0025) -- but biometry is measured by a sonographer FROM these images, so this is measurement recovery, not cross-modal information. Everything else -- Doppler -0.040, cardiac 0.093, and the best non-habitus registry hit (blood pressure, 0.215 -> 0.037 once BMI enters) -- is null. There is no clinically meaningful multimodal signal in the sense of one modality carrying information another lacks.
WHAT_THIS_IS_WORTH: this is a real and reportable negative result, and it is stronger than the earlier block-level nulls because it is exhaustive rather than selective: not 'we tried five methods' but 'we tested every tabular variable in the registry individually'. It also identifies WHAT the frozen encoder does encode -- acquisition conditions -- which is a useful caution for anyone applying foundation-model embeddings to clinical ultrasound.
caveats: screen is univariate per variable; a multivariate combination could in principle carry signal none of the parts do, though the block-level arm tested exactly that and found only maternal
no BH correction applied to the screen itself -- it is used as a ranking, and every candidate was then tested individually with permutation nulls, which is the safer order
pooled per-fetus image representation; a plane-specific or region-specific representation is untested
477 of 1013 numeric columns survive the coverage and level filters; low-coverage variables are unrepresented
the growth arm was initially reported as a degenerate null (-0.179) because the covariate set was the target; corrected to +0.159 p=0.0025, and reinterpreted as measurement recovery

CORRECTION_growth_arm.defect: the growth arm's '+biom' rung used the growth block ITSELF as the nuisance covariate set (BIOi = the growth indices; target = the same indices). The target was residualised on itself, so the residual is ~0 by construction and -0.179 / p=1.000 could not show signal regardless of the data.
CORRECTION_growth_arm.valid_adjustment: biometry cannot be a covariate for a biometry target, and EFW is itself a growth variable, so the only admissible nuisance terms are GA and maternal BMI (the acquisition confound)
CORRECTION_growth_arm.THE_GROWTH_ARM_IS_POSITIVE: raw +0.212 -> GA +0.218 -> GA+BMI +0.159, permutation p=0.0025 against a null p95 of 0.077. Images DO carry fetal-biometry information that survives both gestational age and the maternal-habitus confound. The invalid rung had inverted this to a null.
CORRECTION_growth_arm.BUT_IT_IS_NOT_CROSS_MODAL_DISCOVERY: the biometry z-scores are measured BY A SONOGRAPHER FROM THESE SAME ULTRASOUND IMAGES. Image-appearance predicting AC/HC/FL is measurement recovery -- the images contain the structures the measurements were taken from -- not evidence of a modality carrying information another lacks. It is a positive control for the pipeline (the encoder does see fetal anatomy) rather than a fusion finding.
